verdict.rationale: Square documents a Payouts API (square-docs-17), and agents get good programmatic access through the official MCP server, whose generic make_api_request covers the 'full Square API platform', and through the llms.txt agent guidance on cursor pagination. However, the evidence only names the Payouts API. Nothing shows payout line items or balance-transaction entries, or how to map a bank deposit back to its individual payments, fees and refunds. Missing for 10: documented payout-entry or balance-transaction detail, a per-deposit to per-charge reconciliation linkage, payouts explicitly listed in the MCP service catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a reconciliation workflow.
